data.title: First Day Introduces First-of-Its-Kind 8-in-1 Protein + Fiber + Collagen Ready-To-Pour Liquid Packets for the Whole Family
data.description:
First Day Introduces First-of-Its-Kind 8-in-1 Protein + Fiber + Collagen Ready-To-Pour Liquid Packets for the Whole Family

First Day Introduces First-of-Its-Kind 8-in-1 Protein + Fiber + Collagen Ready-To-Pour Liquid Packets for the Whole Family

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Nov. 23, 2026

The family nutrition brand reimagines traditional protein and fiber supplements with an innovative ready-to-pour liquid format combining complete protein, five sources of fiber, and collagen in one convenient liquid packet.

NEW YORK, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, First Day announces the first-of-its-kind Ready-to-Pour Protein + Fiber + Collagen 8-in-1 Complex Liquid Packets, marking a major expansion beyond its signature gummies into functional nutrition.

 First Day launches a ready-to-pour liquid packet combining complete protein, five sources of fiber, and collagen

Available in age-specific formulas for kids, teens, and adults, the new complex introduces an unparalleled liquid format that combines complete protein for muscle health, a 5-fiber blend for digestive support, and in the teens and adults formulas, VERISOL® Bioactive Collagen Peptides, clinically studied to improve skin elasticity, boost hydration, and visibly reduce fine lines and wrinkles. VERISOL® is specifically developed to support the skin's natural collagen production, delivering clinically studied beauty-from-within benefits in as little as eight weeks. Together, these ingredients create an innovative 3-in-1 formula designed to help close common nutritional gaps and support everyday wellness for the whole family.

The new Ready-to-Pour liquid packets were developed to address common frustrations with traditional protein and fiber supplements. According to a recent 2026 consumer study, 84% of moms surveyed said protein powders clump, while 82% found liquid packets more appealing than traditional powders, shakes, and tubs.* Additionally, more than 90% of U.S. adults fall short of their daily fiber target, further highlighting the need for convenient ways to support daily nutrition.

Powered by First Day's innovative Bio-Liquid Technology, the formula features active ingredients that come already dissolved, eliminating the clumping and gritty residue commonly associated with traditional protein powders. Each ready-to-pour packet mixes directly into water, offering a simpler alternative to traditional powders and shakes, with no scooping or blending required.

The new Ready-to-Pour Protein + Fiber + Collagen Liquid Packets feature age-specific formulations, including:

  • Kids (Ages 4–12): 6g of protein, 4g of fiber, and bioactive collagen peptides to support growth, daily nutrition, digestive health, and healthy bone development.
  • Teens (Ages 13–17): 10g of protein, 7g of fiber, and 2.5g of VERISOL® collagen to support muscle health, digestion, and healthy hair, skin, and nails.
  • Adults (Ages 18+): 15g of protein, 8g of fiber, and 2.5g of VERISOL® collagen peptides to support muscle health, digestive wellness, skin elasticity, and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles.

Available in Peach Mango and Lemonade flavors, the new Ready-to-Pour Liquid Packets are offered in 15-count packs for $49.00. 8-count packs will debut at Target stores in late December for $29.99. Pricing varies by retailer.

"We've always believed that better nutrition should be simple and accessible for the whole family," said Alice Li, Founder and CEO of First Day. "With Ready-to-Pour, we're reaching beyond gummies to make everyday wellness even easier, without compromising on the quality and science-backed approach families expect from First Day."

Founded by Alice Li in 2019, First Day was inspired by her family's experiences with nutritional hardships and desire to make better nutrition more accessible for families. Since then, First Day has sold more than 100 million gummies and helped over 1.5 million families build healthier habits through thoughtfully formulated, science-backed nutrition products. The launch marks a new chapter for First Day as the brand continues to expand its offerings beyond traditional vitamins and supplements.

First Day's Ready-to-Pour Protein + Fiber + Collagen Liquid Packets are available now at FirstDay.com, with additional availability planned for Amazon and TikTok Shop beginning December 15, 2026, and Target beginning December 28, 2026.

About First Day
Founded in 2019, First Day is one of the fastest-growing health and wellness brands, creating science-backed vitamins and supplements designed for the whole family. Known for its No Junk™ commitment, First Day formulates products without artificial sugars, dyes, fillers, or unnecessary ingredients, using clinically studied nutrients that are designed for optimal absorption. Trusted by over 1.5 million families, First Day continues to set a new standard for clean, effective, and delicious nutrition. Learn more at www.firstday.com.

*Source: First Day Consumer Attributes Study from May 2026.

data.title: i-80 Gold Announces the Start of Production Mining at Archimedes Underground
data.description:
i-80 Gold Announces the Start of Production Mining at Archimedes Underground

i-80 Gold Announces the Start of Production Mining at Archimedes Underground

PR Newswire

TORONTO, Nov. 23, 2026

All amounts are expressed in United States dollars unless otherwise stated

TORONTO, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- i-80 GOLD CORP. (NYSE: IAUX) (TSX: IAU) ("i-80 Gold", or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has mined its first gold and commenced production mining on schedule at its Archimedes underground project ("Archimedes" or the "Project"). Archimedes is a high-grade gold project located on the Company's Ruby Hill property within the Battle Mountain-Eureka gold trend in Nevada, USA. It is the Company's second underground mine to come online.

"The start of production mining at Archimedes marks another significant step for i-80 Gold, further strengthening our track record of delivering on key development milestones," stated Paul Chawrun, Executive Vice President & Chief Operating Officer. "We are currently mining oxide and sulfide material at the Project. The oxide material is being placed on the active heap leach pad on the Ruby Hill property, while the sulfide material is being stockpiled for processing at our Lone Tree Plant next year. Our strong technical and operating teams and our underground mining contractor have enabled us to deliver on this milestone safely, on time and largely on budget."

Mr. Chawrun added, "Our focus for the Project now turns to ramping up mining rates through 2027 and stockpiling the refractory material mined in preparation for the commissioning of the Lone Tree Plant late in the year as Archimedes will be a key source of high-grade refractory material feed. Once the Lone Tree Plant is commissioned, we are targeting consolidated annual gold production of 150,000 to 200,000 ounces beginning in 2028 from the Archimedes and Granite Creek underground projects."(1) 

Project Development

Production mining commenced following the scheduled completion of the surface and underground infrastructure required to begin production mining, including ventilation and escape raises. Lateral development to date totals approximately 3,600 meters. Ground conditions remain favorable, and the underground contractor continues to exceed planned productivity rates within the Project's upper 426 Zone. Construction of additional surface and underground infrastructure, such as additional ventilation raises, a permanent mine dry, and offices, will continue through 2027 to support the ramp up to planned mining rates. 

Project construction commenced in September 2025 and has progressed largely in line with the capital development estimate in the March 2025 preliminary economic assessment (the "PEA"),(2) apart from the decision to expand and upgrade surface infrastructure to support the scale of future operations. Upon anticipated completion of the additional surface and underground infrastructure in 2027, total project capital is expected to be approximately $10 million higher than the $47.3 million estimated in the PEA.

Processing and Stockpiling 

Archimedes is a high-grade gold project consisting of sulfide (refractory) mineralized material as well as oxide mineralized material predominately in the upper 426 Zone. The recently completed 2025-2026 drilling program for the upper 426 Zone intersected significant intervals of oxide mineralization outside the mineral resource estimate contained in the PEA (refer to the Company's press release dated June 25, 2026). Metallurgical test work results have confirmed that the oxide material is amenable to heap leaching on the Ruby Hill property at lower overall processing costs compared to processing through the Company's oxide mill circuit at the Lone Tree Plant.

Beginning in mid-November, oxide material mined from the upper 426 Zone was placed on the existing heap leach pad on the Ruby Hill property, and the Company expects to begin recovering the associated gold in the first quarter of 2027.

Mining development rates at Archimedes are progressing faster than outlined in the PEA and moreover, the Company expects the majority of the mineralized material mined in 2027 to be oxide and to be placed on the existing heap leach pad. While the PEA assumed some tonnage being placed on the leach pad in 2027, the majority of the mineralized material mined was expected to be sulfide and toll milled at a 58% payability factor. Given the Company believes a majority of the mined mineralized material in 2027 to be oxide, it is expected that the Company will be able to increase its heap leach production outlook.(3) Full guidance will be provided early in the new year.

As previously disclosed, in 2027 the Company expects to stockpile all refractory material mined at Archimedes, along with a large portion of oxide and refractory material mined at Granite Creek underground. The stockpiled material is intended to be processed at the Company's wholly owned Lone Tree Plant upon its planned commissioning in the fourth quarter of 2027, rather than processed at a third-party facility. Additionally, over the next three years a significant portion of mineralized material mined at the Project is expected to be oxide and placed on the Ruby Hill leach pad.

2027 Planned Feasibility Study

Drilling in the upper 426 Zone was completed in April 2026. Drilling in the lower 426 and Ruby Deeps zones commenced in the second quarter of 2026. Seven underground drill rigs are currently active on site targeting approximately 55,000 meters planned across 140 drill holes. The drilling campaign is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 2027 and is designed to evaluate extensions to the mineralized system and enhance resource definition to support the Archimedes feasibility study, which is planned for completion in the second half of 2027.(2)

As of December 31, 2025, Archimedes hosts an Indicated Mineral Resource of 1.8 million tonnes containing 436,000 ounces of gold grading 7.6 grams per tonne and an Inferred Mineral Resource of 4.2 million tonnes containing 988,000 ounces of gold grading 7.3 grams per tonne.(4) The majority of the current Mineral Resource Estimate is hosted in the Ruby Deeps Zone, located below the 5,100-foot elevation of the deposit as demonstrated in the Figure below.

Technical Disclosure and Qualified Person

The technical information contained in this press release has been prepared under the supervision of, and has been reviewed and approved by Paul Chawrun P.Eng., Executive Vice President & Chief Operating Officer, for the Company, who is a qualified person within the meaning of National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101") and Subpart 1300 of Regulation S-K under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended ("S-K 1300"). Mr. Chawrun has verified the scientific and technical information disclosed in this press release.

Endnotes

(1)

Based on gold output estimates in the most recent life of mine gold output schedules disclosed in the latest technical studies filed for each respective project and related property: Granite Creek underground, Archimedes underground, Cove underground, and Mineral Point open pit. These anticipated output figures are preliminary in nature and are largely based on mineral resources, which do not have demonstrated economic viability and subject to successful project development. Only Granite Creek underground has declared mineral reserves. In addition, for all gold projects except Granite Creek underground, the foregoing technical reports are preliminary economic assessments/initial assessments that are preliminary in nature. The Granite Creek underground technical report was a feasibility study/technical report summary.  Each include an economic analysis that is based, in part, on inferred mineral resources. Inferred mineral resources are considered too speculative geologically to have economic considerations applied to them that would enable them to be categorized as mineral reserves. As such, there is no certainty that the output targets will be realized. Anticipated output targets are also pending the commissioning of the Lone Tree Plant and are Company goals and not a projection of results and should not be taken as output guidance. All of the Company's projects other than Granite Creek underground are considered exploration stage projects under S-K 1300, as the Company has not determined mineral reserves at such properties pursuant to S-K 1300. With respect to Archimedes underground, located on the Ruby Hill property, the Company has started extraction activities without determining mineral reserves. The following technical reports for each project and related property have been prepared in accordance with NI 43-101: Preliminary Economic Assessment Technical Report for the Cove Project, Lander County, Nevada (March 31, 2025); NI 43-101 Technical Report Feasibility Study Granite Creek, Humboldt County, Nevada, USA (September 21, 2026); and Preliminary Economic Assessment NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Ruby Hill Project, Eureka County Nevada, USA (March 31, 2025). Corresponding technical reports prepared in accordance with S-K 1300 are as follows: Initial Assessment & Technical Report Summary for the Cove Project, Lander County, Nevada (March 26, 2025); S-K 1300 SEC Technical Report Summary Pre-Feasibility Study Granite Creek, Humboldt County, NV (September 21, 2026); and Initial Assessment of the Ruby Hill Project, Eureka County NV (March 29, 2025).

(2)

See the discussion of the Archimedes Underground project in the Company's S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary, Initial Assessment for the Ruby Hill Complex, Eureka County, Nevada effective December 31, 2024 in the Form 8-K dated March 31, 2025. The PEA was prepared in accordance with NI 43-101 and the corresponding Initial Assessment prepared under S-K 1300 and item 601 of the Regulation S-K, each filed on SEDAR+ and EDGAR, respectively, on March 31, 2025. The planned feasibility study is expected to be prepared under both: NI 43-101 which, in the opinion of the qualified persons, constitutes a feasibility study; and S-K 1300 which, in the opinion of the qualified persons, constitutes a pre-feasibility study.

(3)

The oxide mineralized material mined and expected to be mined at Archimedes includes material that, as previously disclosed, is outside the mineral resource estimate supporting the PEA and has not been classified as mineral resources or mineral reserves. The Company is not providing an estimate of the quantity or grade of this material at this time, and its contribution to heap leach production will depend on the results of mining and leaching.

About i-80 Gold Corp.

i-80 Gold Corp. is a Nevada-focused mining company committed to building a mid-tier gold producer through a funded development plan to advance its high-quality asset portfolio. The Company is one of the largest mineral resource holders in the state with a pipeline of high-grade multi-stage projects strategically located in Nevada's most prolific gold-producing trends. Leveraging its central processing facility following an anticipated refurbishment, i-80 Gold is executing a hub-and-spoke regional mining and processing strategy to maximize efficiency and growth. i-80 Gold's shares are listed on the NYSE (NYSE: IAUX) and the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: IAU). For more information, visit www.i80gold.com.

data.title: Par Health Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Certain Lots of Six Injectable Drug Products Due to the Presence of Particulate Matter
data.description:
Par Health Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Certain Lots of Six Injectable Drug Products Due to the Presence of Particulate Matter

Par Health Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Certain Lots of Six Injectable Drug Products Due to the Presence of Particulate Matter

PR Newswire

ROCHESTER, Mich., Nov. 23, 2026

ROCHESTER, Mich., Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Par Health is recalling 46 lots across six injectable drug products to the hospital/user level. This recall is being conducted due to the presence of particulate matter, identified as cellulose, polystyrene, stopper material, and aluminum that was detected in certain lots.

Risk Statement: Administration of the following injectable products found to contain particulate matter, has a reasonable probability of causing life-threatening adverse health consequences including pulmonary emboli (blockage in pulmonary blood vessels), occlusions of other blood vessels (which can lead to tissue death and possible organ damage), and/or inflammation of the walls of veins, which may lead to clotting. To date, Par Health has not received any reports of adverse events related to this recall.

The products are used as indicated below:

  • Brevital® Sodium 500 mg/vial CIV (Methohexital Sodium for Injection, USP) is formulated for intravenous infusion in adult patients or intramuscular induction in pediatric patients. The product is indicated as an ultra-short-acting barbiturate anesthetic primarily used for the induction of anesthesia and procedural sedation.

  • Coly-Mycin M® Parenteral (colistimethate for injection, USP) 150 mg/vial is an antibacterial product indicated for the treatment of certain acute and chronic infections caused by susceptible gram-negative bacteria, including Enterobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. It may also be used for the initial treatment of serious suspected gram-negative infections.

  • Dantrium® Intravenous (dantrolene sodium for injection) 20 mg/vial is a medication indicated for the treatment and prevention of malignant hyperthermia in susceptible individuals, including use during acute malignant hyperthermia crises.

  • Doxycycline for Injection, USP 100 mg/vial is a broad-spectrum tetracycline antibiotic indicated for the treatment of a wide range of bacterial infections, including certain respiratory, skin, soft tissue, genitourinary, gastrointestinal, rickettsial, and zoonotic infections. It is also indicated for the treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis of anthrax and serves as an alternative therapy for certain infections when penicillin cannot be used.

  • Ethacrynate Sodium for Injection, USP 50 mg/vial is a diuretic indicated for the treatment of edema in certain adult and pediatric patients associated with cardiac, hepatic, and renal disorders, as well as certain other fluid-retention conditions, particularly when rapid fluid removal or intravenous administration is necessary.

  • Micafungin for Injection (50 mg/vial and 100mg/vial) is an antifungal product indicated for the treatment of serious Candida infections in adult and pediatric patients and for the prevention of Candida infections in patients undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

These lots were distributed nationwide to wholesalers and hospitals between July 2, 2024 and September 17, 2026.

Par Health is providing written notification to wholesale and hospital accounts that have received the affected lots and is arranging for return of all existing inventory through Inmar, Inc. Wholesale distributors and hospital pharmacies that have the product being recalled should immediately discontinue use and stop distribution. If you have further distributed the recalled product, please notify your accounts or any additional locations which may have received the recalled product.

Consumers with questions regarding this recall can be directed to Inmar, Inc. at 1-844-940-1986 Monday through Friday between the hours of 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET or by email at rxrecalls@inmar.com.

For medical or technical product information or to report a product complaint or adverse event please call 1-800-828-9393 Monday through Thursday between the hours of 9 a.m. and 8 p.m. ET or Friday between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. ET.

Adverse reactions or quality problems experienced with the use of this product may be reported to the FDA's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program either online, by regular mail or by fax.

  • Complete and submit the report Online: www.fda.gov/medwatch/report.htm 
  • Regular Mail or Fax: Download form www.fda.gov/MedWatch/getforms.htm or call 1-800-332-1088 to request a reporting form, then complete and return to the address on the pre-addressed form, or submit by fax to 1-800-FDA-0178

This recall is being conducted with the knowledge of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

data.title: Quebecor 'Encouraged' After Initial Talks With Telus
data.description:
By Paul Vieira

OTTAWA--Quebecor said its chief executive, Pierre-Karl Peladeau, met with his Telus counterpart on Monday, and was encouraged with a willingness to pursue further talks on a possible tieup.

Peladeau's meeting with Telus CEO Victor Dodig emerged one week after Quebecor unveiled a $22 billion bid to acquire the telecom rival. Quebecor has argued a deal with Telus would create a formidable Canadian-based telecom with the financial and technological wherewithal to counter a pending threat from space firms for wireless phone consumers.

Peladeau "is pleased that the discussion was initiated between both companies' top executives, and encouraged to see a willingness to pursue it," Quebecor said in a 53-word statement sent via email. The statement added that the two sides have agreed to keep discussion confidential.

A spokesman for Telus did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Telus said executive and board members have identified elevated risks with the proposed transaction, tied to regulatory approval. Quebecor is offering stock-and-cash to Telus shareholders.

Canadian antitrust and telecommunications regulators would need to sign off on Quebecor-Telus tieup. Canadian officials have in recent years highlighted the need to improve competition in certain sectors, such as telecommunications and banking.

data.title: SurgePays Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $17.3 Million, Up 6.5% Sequentially, and 2026 Nine-Month Revenue of $49.5 Million, Up 21.3% Year-Over-Year
data.description:
Point of sale and prepaid services revenue grew 15.1% year-over-year while general and administrative expenses declined 15.4%

Completed ClearLine sale during the quarter; GrowthLine opened to partner brands after quarter end

Ended the quarter with $4.7 million in cash and stockholders’ equity of $7.9 million

BARTLETT, Tenn., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SurgePays, Inc. (NASDAQ: SURG) (“SurgePays” or the “Company”), a fintech company that launches and runs wireless brands, today announced its financial results for the third quarter and first nine-month period ended September 30, 2026.

“During the third quarter we strategically focused SurgePays’ business model on our core prepaid wireless and fintech businesses, completing the sale of ClearLine and reporting our first full quarter under the amended AT&T agreement. Third quarter revenue totaled $17.3 million,(1) an increase of 6.5% sequentially, and nine-month revenue totaled $49.5 million, up 21.3% over the same period last year. Our point of sale and prepaid services business grew 15.1% year-over-year, while general and administrative expenses declined 15.4%. With this focus and a stronger balance sheet, we are positioned to grow on infrastructure we have already built. That is how we intend to build value for the Company,” said Brian Cox, Chief Executive Officer of SurgePays.

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Revenue of $17.27 million, up 6.5% from $16.20 million in the second quarter of 2026 and down 7.6% from $18.68 million in the third quarter of 2025. Revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $49.45 million, up 21.3% from $40.78 million in the prior year period.
  • Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services segment revenue of $15.10 million, up 15.1% from $13.12 million in the prior year quarter. Nine-month segment revenue of $43.90 million was up 43.2%.
  • Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) segment revenue of $2.08 million, compared with $5.56 million in the prior year quarter. The decrease reflects the pause in new user intake by the Company’s Eligible Telecommunications Carrier following an audit delay in the fourth quarter of 2025, as described in the Company’s Form 10-Q.
  • MVNO segment gross margin improved to (23.1)% from (47.2)%, and the MVNO gross loss narrowed to $0.48 million from $2.63 million. The quarter was the first full quarter under the amended AT&T agreement.
  • Total gross loss of $2.84 million, compared with $2.60 million in the prior year quarter. Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services gross margin was (16.4)% compared with 0.2%, and the Company expects to focus on improving gross margin in that segment during the remainder of 2026.
  • General and administrative expenses of $3.68 million, down 15.4% from $4.35 million. Nine-month general and administrative expenses of $11.82 million were down 10.1%.
  • Income from operations of $20.65 million, compared with a loss from operations of $6.95 million in the prior year quarter, including the $27.17 million non-cash gain on the sale of the ClearLine platform assets.
  • Net income available to common stockholders of $18.11 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, or $0.41 per basic share and $0.34 per diluted share, which includes a non-cash gain of $27.17 million on the sale of the ClearLine platform assets, compared with a net loss of $7.49 million, or $(0.38) per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Nine-month net income was $7.35 million compared with a net loss of $22.21 million.
  • Net cash used in operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 improved to $12.49 million from $17.73 million.
  • Cash and cash equivalents of $4.68 million at September 30, 2026, compared with $1.73 million at December 31, 2025.
  • Total stockholders’ equity was $7.85 million, compared with a stockholders’ deficit of $15.40 million at December 31, 2025.

Third Quarter Operational Highlights

  • Completed the first full quarter under Amendment No. 2 to the AT&T agreement, which replaced the pricing schedule and removed all minimum spend commitments. The Company had no remaining minimum spend commitments under the agreement at September 30, 2026.
  • Formed Redline Wireless Group, LLC in August, a joint venture 51% owned by SurgePays as managing member, to distribute LinkUp Mobile prepaid wireless service through the independent dealer channel of a national wireless master distribution organization.
  • Completed the sale of the ClearLine platform assets on September 10, 2026 to a subsidiary of GPO Plus, Inc. in exchange for 25,000,000 shares of GPO Plus Series D Preferred Stock. In connection with the sale, SurgePays holds a put option giving it the right to sell the Series D Preferred Stock, or the common stock it converts into, for $27.5 million in cash through December 9, 2029. The sale did not affect the Company’s prepaid top-up, fintech transaction processing, MVNO or MVNE operations.
  • Signed a non-binding letter of intent on September 17, 2026 with All Prepaid, LLC, dba LowWeeklyPayments, to form a joint venture, 51% owned by SurgePays, to scale the smartphone rent-to-own program across the SurgePays independent retail dealer network, which has onboarded more than 100 dealers.

Subsequent Events

  • On October 15, 2026, the Company announced that GrowthLine by SurgePays is open to partner brands. GrowthLine supports more than 200,000 subscribers across SurgePays platforms. Partners join under a revenue share agreement or a joint venture in which SurgePays is majority owner and managing member.
  • On October 29, 2026, the Company announced a definitive agreement with IP Mobile, LLC (iPMobile), which will serve as the exclusive rural broadband sales channel partner for GrowthLine. iPMobile expects to bring more than 15 rural broadband brands onto GrowthLine over the next 12 months.
  • On November 3, 2026, the Company announced a prepaid wireless agreement for SurgePays POS with Zulie Venture Inc. dba Etime system, a payments network serving more than 1,000 retail locations. Etime system has committed to at least $48 million in prepaid wireless purchase volume from October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027, a minimum of $4 million a month, and the volume began running in early October. The Company expects SurgePays POS transactions to exceed $10 million per month by the end of 2026.

Preliminary October 2026 Revenue

The Company is also reporting that, based on preliminary, unaudited results, total revenue for October 2026 exceeded $10 million for the month.

“The third quarter was when we changed how SurgePays operates, with new carrier economics, continued growth in point of sale and prepaid services, and a sharper focus after the ClearLine sale. October is our first read on what that business produces, and preliminary revenue above $10 million is an encouraging sign that those changes are working,” said Mr. Cox.

“We see growth trending toward custom branded wireless, and we want a bigger share of it,” added Mr. Cox. “GrowthLine removes the years and cost of building a wireless operation, so our partners can put their entire budget into customer acquisition and add subscribers faster. Those subscribers run on infrastructure we have already built, and we share in the margin on each one, or hold majority ownership in a joint venture, without funding that customer acquisition ourselves. Separately, through the joint venture we are pursuing with LowWeeklyPayments, we intend to scale our smartphone rent-to-own program across our independent dealer network.”

(1)         All numbers herein rounded and approximate.

About SurgePays, Inc.

SurgePays, Inc. (NASDAQ: SURG) is a fintech company that launches and runs wireless brands. Through its GrowthLine platform, SurgePays provides partners with carrier access, technology, payments, customer care, compliance and daily operations from platforms it developed and an operations center and NOC it runs. The Company also owns LinkUp Mobile, its own prepaid wireless brand, and operates SurgePays POS, which handles retail sales and payments for wireless companies at neighborhood stores. SurgePays brings affordable wireless service and prepaid financial products to consumers through partners and neighborhood stores. For more information, please visit www.surgepays.com.

Forward Looking Statements

This press release contains forward looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward looking statements include, without limitation, statements regarding the Company's expected sales growth across its channels, the Company's ability to extend sequential revenue growth, the Company's platform scaling, and other statements that are not historical facts. Forward looking statements are based on management's current expectations and assumptions and involve known and unknown risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Factors that could cause actual results to differ include, without limitation, the Company's ability to scale subscriber count, the terms and performance of MVNE partnerships, regulatory changes affecting subsidized wireless programs and universal service programs, changes in consumer demand, competitive dynamics in prepaid wireless and retail platform services, and the additional risk factors described in the Company's filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including the most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K and subsequent Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q. Forward looking statements speak only as of the date of this release. The Company disclaims any obligation to update forward looking statements, except as required by law.

data.title: Tech Surges After Nvidia Reinstates Huang - Tech Roundup
data.description:
Shares of technology companies surged after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive.

"The question is are his talents so great that it justifies his shortcomings...time will tell," said J.D. Joyce, president of Houston financial advisory Joyce Wealth Management. Joyce said another risk was that Huang's appointment after such "brazen" ethical lapses was that more lapses could occur. "Are they viewing this from a short-term or a long-term basis?" wondered Joyce. "It could be a short-term fix that propels the stock upwards. But if he acts the same way longer term..."

Shares of Anthropic fell, nearing its initial-public offering price, amid concerns about the AI laboratory's profit prospects. Anthropic's bonds look set to be rated in the junk category following its market debut, amid concerns about its plans to raise $900 billion to fund computing power.
